name: Create a sign-up form
description: Create a subscription (sign-up) form that collects contacts. Free plan allows full-page/embedded forms; pop-up forms need the Professional plan. The UI also has Unsubscribe and Profile update form types, whose type values were not captured. The public API has no form endpoints.

id.description: Form id (24-char hex string, not an integer).

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Created 'Catalogo teste formulario'.

side_effects: Creates a form with a default 'Newsletter' design. The UI then opens the form designer; design edits were not captured.
